li.p: Do not solely rely on i-Pedal to stop the vehicle. Stopping the vehicle may not be possible depending on vehicle and road conditions. Pay attention to the road condition ahead and apply the brake if necessary.

Avoid increasing the regenerative braking level suddenly on slippery roads (like snow or icy conditions) because it may lead slipping of the tires and skidding of vehicle. It can be dangerous due to the loss of the vehicle’s steering force.

note.p: When the vehicle is stopped or parked by i-Pedal on the steep hills, be sure to depress the brake pedal.
